# Feature 3: soft delete for comments

Deleted comments stay in the database but leave comment lists.

## Rules
Values are not copied here. Paths are under app/src/.
- R1 Delete behavior: app/routes/article/article.service.ts, deleteComment. This feature changes it.
- R2 List contents: app/routes/article/article.service.ts, getCommentsByArticle.
- R3 Comment fields: prisma/schema.prisma, model Comment. Preferred over app/routes/article/comment.model.ts, which omits authorId.
- R4 Error shape and status codes: app/models/http-exception.model.ts, error handler in main.ts.
- R5 Delete response: app/routes/article/article.controller.ts, DELETE comment route.
- R6 Delete ownership checks: deleteComment in article.service.ts.
- R7 Schema change: app/README.md, prisma/migrations/.

## Plan
1. Add nullable deletedAt to Comment, with a new migration. Leave old migrations alone.
2. deleteComment sets deletedAt. Keep R6 checks in order.
3. deleteComment and updateComment treat a comment with deletedAt set as not found.
4. getCommentsByArticle leaves out comments with deletedAt set.
5. R4 and R5 stay as they are.

file.content:
datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

generator client {
  provider        = "prisma-client-js"
  previewFeatures = []
}

model Article {
  id          Int       @id @default(autoincrement())
  slug        String    @unique
  title       String
  description String
  body        String
  createdAt   DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime  @default(now())
  tagList     Tag[]
  author      User      @relation("UserArticles", fields: [authorId], onDelete: Cascade, references: [id])
  authorId    Int
  favoritedBy User[]    @relation("UserFavorites")
  comments    Comment[]
}

model Comment {
  id        Int      @id @default(autoincrement())
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @default(now())
  body      String
  article   Article  @relation(fields: [articleId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  articleId Int
  author    User     @relation(fields: [authorId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  authorId  Int
}

model Tag {
  id       Int       @id @default(autoincrement())
  name     String    @unique
  articles Article[]
}

model User {
  id         Int       @id @default(autoincrement())
  email      String    @unique
  username   String    @unique
  password   String
  image      String?   @default("https://api.realworld.io/images/smiley-cyrus.jpeg")
  bio        String?
  articles   Article[] @relation("UserArticles")
  favorites  Article[] @relation("UserFavorites")
  followedBy User[]    @relation("UserFollows")
  following  User[]    @relation("UserFollows")
  comments   Comment[]
  demo       Boolean   @default(false)
}

content.text:
Feature 3 (soft delete for comments) is built in `app/`, but I could not run Prisma or Jest here, so nothing is verified by execution.

## Answers to your questions

**1. What happens on delete, and which comments appear in lists?**
Before this change, `deleteComment` hard-deleted the row with `prisma.comment.delete`. `getCommentsByArticle` returns comments whose author has `demo = true`, plus the viewer's own comments when they are logged in. An anonymous viewer therefore sees only demo-author comments. I kept that filter as it was.

**2. What shape must an API error take, and which status codes?**
`HttpException(errorCode, message)` in `app/src/app/models/http-exception.model.ts` is handled in `app/src/main.ts`, which sends `res.status(errorCode).json(message)`. The body is the message as given, with no wrapper. The codes in use are 401, 403, 404, 422 and 500. The bodies vary by call site: 422 and `getArticle`'s 404 use `{ errors: { field: [msg] } }`, other 404s use `{}`, and 403 uses `{ message }`. The repo does not state a single required shape. The README points to the upstream RealWorld spec and to `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`, and neither is in this working directory, so I could not check a shape against them.

## What changed

- `app/src/prisma/schema.prisma`: added `deletedAt DateTime?` to `Comment`.
- `app/src/prisma/migrations/20261030120000_comment_soft_delete/migration.sql`: new migration, `ALTER TABLE "Comment" ADD COLUMN "deletedAt" TIMESTAMP(3);`. Existing migrations are untouched.
- `app/src/app/routes/article/article.service.ts`:
  - `deleteComment` filters on `deletedAt: null`, keeps the 404 then 403 checks in order, and sets `deletedAt` with `update` instead of calling `delete`.
  - `updateComment` filters on `deletedAt: null`, so a deleted comment is a 404. This is plan step 3 of the spec.
  - `getCommentsByArticle` adds `deletedAt: null` next to the existing `OR` filter.
- `app/src/tests/services/article.comment-soft-delete.service.test.ts` (new): covers soft delete, deleted comments returning 404 on delete and edit, and the list filter.
- `app/src/tests/services/article.service.test.ts`: one assertion changed. The existing `updateComment` test checks the exact `where` clause, so I added `deletedAt: null` to it.

Two things to know about files you already had in progress:
- `updateComment` and its tests are uncommitted work from feature 1. I edited around them and did not revert anything.
- `article.controller.ts` is unchanged by this feature. R5 stays as it is.

## Rules applied

- **R1 delete behavior:** soft delete, set `deletedAt` to the current time. Source: `article.service.ts` `deleteComment`, plus spec plan step 2.
- **R2 list contents:** exclude comments with `deletedAt` set, keep the demo and own-author filter. Source: `article.service.ts` `getCommentsByArticle`.
- **R3 comment fields:** `deletedAt DateTime?` on `Comment`. Source: `prisma/schema.prisma` `model Comment`. I used the schema over `comment.model.ts`, which has no `deletedAt` and omits `authorId`. The two do not disagree on any value this feature uses.
- **R4 error shape and status codes:** `HttpException(status, body)`, sent as the body with no wrapper. A deleted comment returns 404 with `{}`, matching the existing not-found path in `deleteComment`. Source: `app/src/app/models/http-exception.model.ts` and `app/src/main.ts`.
- **R5 delete response:** unchanged, `200` with `{}`. Source: `article.controller.ts` DELETE comment route.
- **R6 ownership checks:** 404 when no matching comment exists for this author, then 403 when the author differs. The order is unchanged. The 403 branch cannot be reached because the query already filters on author. I left it in place as the spec asks.
- **R7 schema change:** a new migration folder under `prisma/migrations/`. Source: `app/README.md` (`npx prisma migrate deploy`). The README does not give a naming rule, so I used the timestamp_name pattern of the existing folders.

## Not verified

- I could not run `npx prisma generate`, `npx prisma migrate deploy`, or Jest. The new `deletedAt` fields will not type-check until the client is regenerated. Please run both before merging.
- The tests check the query filters with mocks. They do not prove the database returns the right rows. A test against a real database would be needed for that.
